review.assessment:
This is an observed independent review of public bytes for the staged negative preflight component only. It makes no private-memory or OS secrecy claim. It gives no credit for whole #43, positive or native behaviour, CI, merge, or any private producer gate. All mandatory gates stay open and none is waived: #19, #23, #41, #43, #14, #8, #9, #12, #15, #58, #60, native containment, recovery, the migrated positive fixture suite, full regression and exact-source CI. Requirements9 and Design10 are unchanged. The unapproved #19 Design35 at 0993d2e is used as context only.

R43-S1-L1 is closed. require_managed_native_binding_composed() is a private, unconditional refusal. It runs after the static capability check, probe, identity check and probed-capability check, and before clear_hold, prepare_pack, reserve and the marker. Even a fully consistent advertiser therefore cannot reach the legacy Task-rewriting binder. The guard is the only native launch path to cover: step to prepare_agent is the sole native start site, and resume_gate, retry, escalate, request_finalization and poll launch nothing. Case 6 exercises the fully consistent descriptor. The omit_composition_guard mutant returns Started with a Session, which proves the guard is causal. Because the typed assertions pin each earlier refusal, any mutant that moves the guard ahead of the earlier checks would also be killed.

R43-S1-L2 is closed as an honesty fix. The retained-selection and returned-provider checks are now labelled as implemented but causally unverified. They still need a genuine #19 positive fixture plus actor and provider mutants. The redundant worktree clause is removed, and session.worktree == worktree is retained.

The other Source2 changes are sound:
- NativePreflightRefusal is a #[non_exhaustive], downcastable error.
- Registry and probe failures keep the AdapterError source through anyhow context, so both downcasts work, as the test asserts.
- PhaseAdapterSelection replaces the post-reservation fallible Option conversion. The EvidencePort and native routing match the phase actor exactly.
- The eight probe and descriptor cases and the three controls compare complete durable state with zero launches.
- The seven isolated, committed mutants each fail at the intended consumer through a typed or state assertion, not at compilation or setup.
- The exact tree is restored and the controls pass.

R43-S1-L3 (synchronous probe) is honestly left open as a co-integration condition rather than claimed closed. The submission's correction is right: my earlier suggestion of a bare spawn_blocking with a timeout would detach unfinished work and cannot meet #60's ownership contract. A genuinely bounded, owned probe with controls for unrelated progress and cancellation is required. In this slice the probe is reached only after the static capability check, and no real adapter advertises that capability, so it is not a concrete defect here.

As declared:
- the legacy positive Workflow fixture still fails on the missing PreparedInputAdmission; it is not disabled or faked;
- the existing adapter test failure (StateConflict expected, SessionLost observed) is outside this slice, its cause is unmeasured, and it is retained for diagnosis before full CI;
- the branch remains unmergeable.

No Critical, High, Medium or Low defect was found in the staged component.

findings.claim:
The new typed refusal no longer names the selected agent. Source1 reported 'agent {agent} lacks prepared native phase capability {required:?}'. Source2's MissingCapability and IdentityMismatch carry no agent or role, so the message cannot tell an operator whether the Executor or the first reviewer is misconfigured.

This is a small diagnosability regression in the slice. Classification is unaffected, because the typed variant is still downcastable.
findings.evidence: Source2 Display: `Self::MissingCapability(capability) => write!(f, "missing prepared native phase capability {capability:?}")` and `Self::IdentityMismatch => f.write_str("selected adapter probe identity mismatch")`. The refusal sites return `Err(NativePreflightRefusal::MissingCapability(required).into())` without context. Only AdapterUnavailable and ProbeFailed keep the AdapterError text, which includes the agent name for 'unregistered agent'.
findings.fix: Add bounded context with the selected agent name and actor role on top of the typed refusal, for example `Err(anyhow::Error::new(refusal).context(format!("selected agent {agent} for {:?}", phase.actor())))`. Anyhow's downcast_ref still finds the inner refusal type. Assert both the typed variant and the agent in the controls.

findings.claim: The master paragraph on the staged source was not updated for Source2. It says the staged source 'adds only the pre-reservation prepared-admission capability check'. With the unconditional `require_managed_native_binding_composed()` refusal, every native Executor/Reviewer phase on this branch now refuses before reservation, whatever the adapter advertises. The master text still implies that support depends only on whether an adapter advertises the capability.
findings.evidence: The master file is unchanged in the Source2 manifest (blob e5789698…): 'Issue43 staged source adds only the pre-reservation prepared-admission capability check and retained registered/probed selection. Current adapters/legacy fixtures do not advertise that capability until actual19 admission is wired…'. Source2 adds `fn require_managed_native_binding_composed() -> Result<()> { Err(NativePreflightRefusal::ManagedBindingUnavailable.into()) }`, which preflight calls after the probe checks. The issue design and verification documents do describe the guard.
findings.fix: Update the master paragraph in the same change. State that the staged branch refuses ALL native Workflow phases through an explicit composition guard until genuine private admission and record-only binding compose, and that capability metadata alone can never reach the legacy binder.

findings.evidence: issue-43-preflight-source2-checks.json scope: 'focused negative preflight component, not full suite/CI/native readiness'. The control log covers 3 tests. The Source1 artifact records only `all_presets_drive_real_adapter_calls_and_persist_phase_context_history` as the unmigrated failure. The verification text says the adapter failure's cause is unmeasured.
findings.fix: Run the complete workspace suite once at c95ac88 and record the exact pass/fail list and hashes. Classify every failure as expected native-dispatch preflight/composition refusal or as another cause, with zero unexplained failures allowed. Attribute the adapter test by running it at the pre-#43 baseline commit. This is evidence only, with no rerun-to-pass and no change to producer scope.

review.assessment:
Reviewed the staged Source2 preflight component delta f2773cc→0bbb652 (source c95ac88; the metadata commit's source is identical) against approved Requirements9 and Design10. The unapproved #19 Design35 (0993d2e) is pinned as a proposal only.

Outcome: approve the staged negative preflight slice only. This does not approve whole-#43, positive, native, CI or private-producer readiness.

My Source1 Lows:
- S1-L1 is closed. PhaseAdapterSelection resolves before reservation. After `reserve` the selection is matched infallibly, with EvidencePort going to evaluate and Native(selection) moving by value. No post-commit fallible conversion bypasses the eligible/release accounting.
- S1-L2 is closed. NativePreflightRefusal is public, non_exhaustive, Copy and implements Error. Registry and probe failures keep their AdapterError through anyhow context, so both downcasts work, and the controls assert typed variants instead of matching strings.
- S1-L3 remains open by declaration. The rationale is accepted: a bare spawn_blocking plus timeout would detach an unfinished job and cannot meet the #60 ownership contract. In this slice no in-tree adapter passes the static check, so no real probe runs, and the owned, bounded probe stays a co-integration gate.

New source verified:
- The private `require_managed_native_binding_composed()` guard runs after all consistency checks and before clear_hold, pack, reserve and the marker. Even a fully consistent spoofed descriptor (case 6) cannot reach the legacy Task-rewriting binder.
- The omit_composition_guard mutant shows the legacy path would otherwise return Started. This closes my Source1 observation that fail-closed relied only on no in-tree advertiser.
- prepare_agent, the only adapter.start caller, is reachable only through step, so the guard covers every native dispatch.
- Removing the redundant worktree clause is behaviour-neutral.

Tests and mutations:
- The eight descriptor/probe cases, the reviewer, unregistered and role cases, and the held-state, zero-probe, no-pack and unchanged-durable-state assertions all exercise the real step and helper.
- The seven compiled, clean, committed mutants are each killed at the intended consumer with recorded assertions. The typed expectations stop the composition guard from masking the capability and identity mutants.
- The exact source and tree are restored, and the three controls pass.

Declared limits, honest and unwaived:
- The retained-selection and returned-provider checks are causally unverified until genuine #19 positive fixtures and actor/provider mutants exist.
- The legacy positive workflow fixtures fail by design; none is disabled or replaced with a synthetic owner.

All mandatory gates stay open:
- the actual #19/#23/#41/#43/#14/#8/#9/#12/#15/#58/#60 producers and the record-only binder/diagnostics, delivered in a single combined co-integration PR;
- the negative-index and non-indexable-scope controls;
- fresh/migrated DDL goldens;
- native 5/6/7 conformance and containment;
- restart recovery;
- the full mutation matrix;
- exact-head CI;
- independent source and security review.

The branch remains unmergeable. This review covers only the supplied public bytes.
